title: Picture quiz drawings
use: Shown only on the picture-quiz page (#sekil). The word map has no pictures.

openmoji.name: OpenMoji 15.1.0, black (line) set
openmoji.changes: Recoloured to currentColor, stroke style moved to the wrapping element, decimals truncated.

soz.name: Line drawings made for SÖZ (scripts/draw_pictures.py)
soz.method: AI-assisted original drawings on the OpenMoji 72 x 72 grid, reviewed on contact sheets.

selection: Candidates come from scripts/build_picture_candidates.py (WordNet category, Brysbaert et al. 2014 concreteness ratings, emoji matches). Each OpenMoji match was checked by eye; mismatched senses, ambiguous drawings and duplicates were dropped. One word is shown per picture.
